photos.desc: line drawing of a small primate walking on 4 legs "Plesiadapis gidleyi" is an early primate that lived during the Paleocene. Fossils of "Plesiadapis" have been found at Big Bend National Park, Texas,
AMNH 129498, collected in Bighorn Basin, Wyoming, 1987, by J. G. M. Thewissen.
